name: Opinio – Easy Polls & Surveys
author: kimtongjoo

sections.description:
Create and manage engaging polls and surveys effortlessly on your WordPress site. Opinio provides a powerful yet lightweight solution to gather user feedback, host voting contests, and analyze user opinions with an intuitive interface.

With our advanced drag-and-drop builder and responsive design, you can create professional-looking polls that blend perfectly with any WordPress theme.

Key Features

  • Advanced UI: Beautiful, modern, and user-friendly interface for both admins and visitors.
  • Drag & Drop Options: Easily reorder, add, or remove poll options with a simple drag-and-drop action.
  • Global Board URL: Manage and display your surveys globally across specific endpoints.
  • Category & Expiration Date: Organize your polls by categories and set custom end dates to close voting automatically.
  • Fully Responsive: Looks stunning on all devices including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress admin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new menu created in your WordPress dashboard to start creating your first poll.
sections.faq:
How do I display a poll on a page or post?

After creating a poll, you will get a unique shortcode. Simply copy and paste that shortcode into any post, page, or widget area.

Can I set a deadline for the survey?

Yes! You can use the “Expiration Date” feature to set a specific date and time when the poll will automatically stop accepting responses.
